id: Would you like to take Gligar with you?
en: Would you like to take Gligar with you?

it: \bAllenarsi sotto la pioggia fortifica la resistenza.

id: \bNobody ever stops to talk with me. Let me share something with you as appreciation.
en: \bNobody ever stops to talk with me. Let me share something with you as appreciation.
it: \bNessuno si ferma mai a parlare con me. Lascia che ti dia qualcosa come ringraziamento.

id: \bI can't wait to speak with you again.
en: \bI can't wait to speak with you again.
it: \bNon vedo l'ora di parlare di nuovo con te.

id: \bMaylene is a powerful Trainer. Are you going to battle her?
en: \bMaylene is a powerful Trainer. Are you going to battle her?
it: \bMaylene è un'Allenatrice potente. Hai intenzione di sfidarla?
\bNon riesco a stare fermo. Devo continuare.

id: \bLovely day for a hike, wouldn't you say?
en: \bLovely day for a hike, wouldn't you say?

id: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
en: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
it: \bGran bella lotta. Buona fortuna con il resto.
\bAncora non posso credere di aver perso.

id: \bOh why did you have to look at me?
en: \bOh why did you have to look at me?
